ruleDefinitions.name: Shell Process Spawned by Java.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects shell spawned from Java host process, which could be a sign of exploitation (e.g. log4j exploitation)

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\java\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\bash\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$"))) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX(".*build.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*build.*")))
